form_subtitle: RoSPA Light, Off-Road & Desert Assessment form
assessment_guidance: This assessment specifies the standard of competence required by the driver for RoSPA Light Vehicle, Off-Road and Desert practical outcomes. Learners must successfully complete all practical exercises. Records of methods used, and assessment results must be maintained.
source_legend: Source of Evidence: O – Observation  S – Simulation  Q – Questioning  W – Witness

criteria.criterion: That you have checked that occupants are wearing a seat belt properly
How to apply and release the parking brake effectively
Moving off safely and under control, after checking for any potential external hazards
How to accelerate smoothly and appropriately
Using the appropriate gear for specific speeds and driving conditions
Driving at the correct speed for the driving conditions coupled with forward distance observation and anticipation of other traffic and potential hazards
Using the footbrake in a controlled manner appropriate to the driving conditions and the distance available
Using the correct hand position on the steering wheel and turning the vehicle smoothly
Using the mirrors before braking, increasing speed, signaling, identifying a hazard and changing direction
Using the mirrors to keep track of other vehicles traveling to the rear or to the side
Using signals, when necessary, in the correct manner and with applicable timing for each situation and maneuver
Responding appropriately to traffic signs, road markings, traffic signals and traffic controllers (e.g., construction areas, crossing guards)
Following traffic at a safe distance
Progressing on the journey at an appropriate speed and without undue hesitation
Approaching junctions at an appropriate speed and without undue hesitation, observing other vehicles and using the correct signal
Positioning the vehicle appropriately in the lanes and during maneuvers
Using judgment when approaching other vehicles, crossing uncontrolled intersections and in overtaking
Reverse parking under control and after observing nearby obstructions
Complete vehicle, tyre and recovery-equipment checks before leaving the sealed road
Set tyre pressures appropriate to the terrain and re-inflate after the exercise
Select the correct gear and technique for approach, departure and ramp-over angles
Maintain vehicle control on uneven, rocky or loose surfaces
Demonstrate correct positioning and speed on inclines and declines
Use recovery points, boards, snatch or winch techniques safely
Assess sand conditions and select a safe route before committing the vehicle
Maintain momentum and correct tyre pressure in soft sand
Demonstrate dune approach, cresting and descent techniques
Recover a vehicle from sand using approved methods
Apply heat, hydration, convoy spacing and emergency procedures in desert conditions
Park and secure the vehicle safely after the desert exercise
